items.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016
items.q: And we were on it and Ray Charles was on it and a bunch of great people.

ctx.x: I know so many musicians in L.A. that I so look up to. And I know a lot of guys that are scuffling. You know, that are having a tough go. That have resumes that would be the envy of anyone. And a lot of it is just due to the changes in the business and our ages, now as middle-aged people, especially in L.A. which is a pretty youth-oriented place. And it was good for me when I was twenty, thirty, even forty-something. But it was so funny. I never thought of it in those terms until an incident happened where I…
I’m trying not to laugh. That’s really a good story.
